title: BESS – Огляд системи
description: BESS MVP: заряд батареї (30–90 %), потоки потужності, ціни РДН, дохід. Доба = UTC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "battery_soc_pct")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

real = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "battery_soc_pct" and r._time <= now())
fc = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_forecast" and r._field == "battery_soc_pct" and r._time > now())
union(tables: [real, fc])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "SoC")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

import "date"
d0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: d0, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "revenue_today_uah")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "date"
d0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
from(bucket: "telemetry")

import "date"
d0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: date.add(d: 1d, to: d0), stop: date.add(d: 2d, to: d0))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_forecast" and r._field == "revenue_today_uah")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "date"
d0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
capex = float(v: "${capex_uah}")
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: date.add(d: -30d, to: d0), stop: d0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "revenue_today_uah")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r._value > 0.0 then capex / (r._value * 30.0) else -1.0}))
